x: Frank Wright our fourth and last runner did 18.22 to come home an easy winner and our total time was 74.31. We also started a " B " team and after the following had run—J.
The Sutton lads reversed the previous result and this time came out on top with 35 pts. to our 47. Geoff Goode was content to run in behind a local lad and he was followed by Gerry Lines, with J.

Brian Trower writes us from the Fighter Plotters School at Middle Wallop, while J. Hills is with the R.A.S.C. at Aldershot, and Don Maclean is now with the R.A. in North Wales and says he is hoping to get in some running while there.

McLean also ran very well to finish 4th, close behind the other "Mac," and both he and Wright are still eligible to compete in the Youths' c.c. races during the present season. J. Hills, also on leave from the Army won the handicap, with R.

Mike Stearman was our first man home in 6th place, then came Brian Trower 12th, Don McLean 14th, and Brian Rice 21st. Both Trower and MacLean are in the Forces, while Rice is at Cambridge University, and J. Hills and Peter Courtney are also in the Forces.
J. Hills finished second in the R.A.S.C. c.c. championship, but has now been posted to the Middle East.
